frequency_question: How often do proposed high-impact agency fee rules successfully transition to a published final rule within 12 months of initial significant signal?
membership_rule: Includes rules categorized as economically significant by OIRA involving major fee restructurings; excludes routine annual fee adjustments and minor technical corrections.

cases.name: SEC Consolidated Audit Trail Fee Rule (2016)
EPA Fee Modernization for Chemical Reviews (2021)
ATF Stabilizing Brace Rule (Fee-adjacent regulatory burden) (2023)
FAA Commercial Space Transportation Fee Rule (2022)

coverage_note: 10 named instances of major economically significant agency fee or high-impact regulatory rules reaching finalization within the designated period.
known_gaps: Does not account for rules that stalled indefinitely prior to reaching the final publication stage, which are typically abandoned quietly rather than formally rejected.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to standard administrative procedure timelines and executive agency rulemaking lifecycles, valid through the current presidential term.
